criterion: A name that exists counts as recognizable when a Rich Python call, translated only by the mechanical Rust adaptations (varargs -> iterator, slice or builder push; keyword arguments -> builder methods or typed fields; omitted defaults -> explicit default value; str -> &str or impl Into<String>; exceptions -> Result; constructor -> Type::new or a named constructor), keeps the same operation, the same argument roles and the same positional order. It does not count when the positional order differs, an argument role is missing without an alternative on the same item, or the same name denotes a different role or type.
sensitivity: 28 of 40 (70.0%) is the threshold. It holds only if Text.stylize and Progress.update are both accepted as recognizable (28/40); with all three contested items accepted the count is 29/40 = 72.5%.
reviewer: evaluation fork, written before counting, applied to every existing name of the list; only hud was reviewed because every pilot candidate already fails another DX threshold

items.name: Console
items.note: Rich Console(...); hud Console::stdout() / stderr() / builder(): constructor named by stream, same role.

items.name: Console.print
items.note: Rich print(*objects, ...); hud print(&renderable): one renderable, groups via Group.

items.name: Text.append
items.note: Rich append(text, style=None); hud append(text, style): explicit default.

items.name: Text.stylize
items.note: Rich stylize(style, start=0, end=None); hud stylize(range: Range<usize>, style: Style): order of roles differs and start/end become a range.

items.name: Table.add_column
items.note: Rich add_column(header, ...); hud add_column(impl Into<Column>), Column::new(header).

items.name: Progress.add_task
items.note: Rich add_task(description, start, total, ...); hud add_task(description, total): total positional and required.

items.name: Progress.advance
items.note: Rich advance(task_id, advance=1); hud advance(task, amount): amount required.

items.name: Progress.update
items.note: Rich update(task_id, *, total, completed, advance, description, visible, ...); hud update(task, completed): the roles total, description and visible are missing on this item.

items.name: Group
items.note: Rich Group(*renderables); hud Group::new().push(item): builder push.

items.name: Padding
items.note: Rich Padding(renderable, pad) wraps a renderable; hud Padding is a four-field spacing value (top, right, bottom, left): the same name denotes a different role.
